nodes.label: Superpowers Default Workflow Process (brainstorm→plan→implement→review→finish)
nodes.rationale: Enforces disciplined development: clarify goals, write a plan with small steps, implement with verification (prefer TDD), do a review pass, finish with summary. Reduces risk of unbounded changes and promotes correctness checks at each step.

nodes.label: Parallel Subagent Execution Strategy
nodes.rationale: Independent plan steps are grouped into batches and spawned as parallel subagents via spawn_subagent.py. Each batch must fully pass verification before the next batch starts, preventing cascading failures.

nodes.label: Execution Artifacts Persistence Pattern
nodes.rationale: Execution notes and summaries are written to disk at artifacts/superpowers/ after each step. This ensures reproducibility and auditability of agent actions independent of IDE state.

nodes.label: Vencore Monorepo Architecture
nodes.rationale: Turborepo + pnpm workspaces monorepo with apps: web (Next.js dashboard), api (Express REST), worker (background jobs), agent (Node.js daemon on customer servers). Multi-tenant with workspace-scoped auth using custom JWT.
